_doc: Root causes and sink -> root cause map for wave B labels. label_evidence null: taken from mlflow_cwe22_labels.csv.

RC-M1.label: false_positive
RC-M1.mechanism_family: F1 interprocedural guard (validator/containment check that raises)
RC-M1.label_note: label unit = the alert as reported (sink + the flows CodeQL reports for it); all reported flows pass the guard; for list_artifacts-based sinks the guard is inside list_artifacts, so unreported callers are covered too

RC-M2.label: false_positive
RC-M2.mechanism_family: F3 infeasible flow (context-insensitive higher-order / virtual dispatch)

RC-M3.label: false_positive
RC-M3.mechanism_family: F1 interprocedural guard (validator/containment check that raises)

RC-M6.label: unknown
RC-M6.mechanism_family: U raw value used after validating a transformed copy
RC-M6.review_status: owner_accepted (unknown; excluded from rule development, used as negative counterexample)

RC-M7.label: false_positive
RC-M7.mechanism_family: F6 taint through outbound HTTP response
RC-M7.label_evidence: serve_gateway_proxy returns gateway_proxy_handler(): the tainted value is response.json() of a request to the server-configured MLFLOW_DEPLOYMENTS_TARGET; CodeQL propagates taint from the URL argument (gateway_path) to the response object. A dict/list is serialised by Flask as application/json; a str body would require the configured upstream to echo attacker markup as a top-level JSON string. Errors go through catch_mlflow_exception (JSON).

RC-D1.label: true_positive
RC-D1.label_evidence: TemplateDetailView: Path(directory) / self.kwargs['template'] then exists()/read_text(), no containment check. Later fixed as GHSA-68w8-qjq3-2gfm / CVE-2021-33203 (affected 3.2 < 3.2.4; scanned commit 05413afa predates it). Precondition: admindocs installed, staff user; by default existence oracle, contents if templates customised.

RC-D2.label: false_positive
RC-D2.mechanism_family: F1 interprocedural guard (validator/containment check that raises)
RC-D2.label_evidence: django.views.static.serve: fullpath = Path(safe_join(document_root, normpath(path).lstrip('/'))); safe_join raises SuspiciousFileOperation unless abspath(join) startswith abspath(base)+sep (or equals base, or base is the filesystem root). All 4 sinks use the returned value; the only other entry (staticfiles.views.serve) passes finders.find() output and still goes through safe_join.

RC-D3.label: true_positive
RC-D3.mechanism_family: T reflected request data in text/html
RC-D3.label_evidence: Test view returns request data (POST QueryDict str / GET param / URL kwarg / FILES field names / request body) in HttpResponse (text/html) without escaping.

RC-D4.label: false_positive
RC-D4.label_evidence: Reflects request.method; an HTTP method is an RFC 9110 token (no '<', '>', quotes).

RC-D5.label: false_positive
RC-D5.label_evidence: Reflects a custom request header (X-ARG-CHECK); a cross-origin page cannot set it without a CORS preflight the view does not allow.

RC-D6.label: true_positive
RC-D6.label_evidence: uploaded file name passes os.path.basename only (pre CVE-2021-31542 fix), so a name '..' makes os.path.exists(UPLOAD_TO/..) look outside UPLOAD_TO; effect is a boolean.

RC-D7.label: false_positive
RC-D7.mechanism_family: F3 infeasible flow (context-insensitive higher-order / virtual dispatch)
RC-D7.label_evidence: Flow reaches PathNotImplementedStorage.exists via Storage.save -> get_available_name -> self.exists over all Storage subclasses; the test storage is only used as STATICFILES_STORAGE in test_management.py, never with the FileField tests that are the sources.

RC-C1.label: false_positive
RC-C1.mechanism_family: F2 allowlist membership of a server-generated key
RC-C1.label_evidence: uuid reaches the sink only after membership in datastore.data['watching'] (diff_history_page: lookup raising KeyError -> redirect; edit_page: 'not in' -> redirect; form_delete: 'not in' -> redirect; checkbox ops: .get(uuid) truthy). Keys are str(uuid.uuid4()) (model/__init__.py:68); add_watch deletes 'uuid' from extras. Flask <string:> converter also excludes '/'.

RC-C2.label: true_positive
RC-C2.label_evidence: static_content: send_from_directory('static/{}'.format(group), path=filename) with group='..' moves the base to the package directory (unauthenticated source file read). Reported as GHSA-9jj8-v89v-xjvw / CVE-2026-25527 (affected < 0.53.2); scanned commit has no sanitisation of group.

RC-C3.label: TP_conditional
RC-C3.label_note: boundary crossed; harm requires a file with the fixed name one level above the datastore
RC-C3.label_evidence: static_content screenshot / visual_selector_data branches: send_from_directory(os.path.join(datastore_path, filename), <fixed name>) with filename='..' (the <string:> converter forbids '/' only; reachability of '..' in this route is shown by the PoC of GHSA-9jj8-v89v-xjvw) reads <datastore parent>/last-screenshot.png or elements.json (Werkzeug 3.0.6 safe_join only checks the fixed name). Docker default -d /datastore: parent is '/'. The upstream fix for CVE-2026-25527 (9d38b45) sanitises filename to [a-z0-9_] before these branches, removing this crossing as well. Password-gated only if a password is set.

RC-C4.label: TP_conditional
RC-C4.mechanism_family: T reflected request data in text/html
RC-C4.label_note: unescaped reflection present; cross-site delivery requires bypassing CSRF (victim token) or CSRF disabled
RC-C4.label_evidence: ajax_callback_send_notification_test returns f'Error:  {n_url} is not a valid AppRise URL.' (Flask str -> text/html) where n_url comes from request.form['notification_urls'] without escaping. Route is POST-only and login_optionally_required (no login when no password is set). CSRFProtect is global and the view is not exempt, so a cross-site form POST is rejected without the victim's token; the in-app caller displays the body with alert(). CSRF limits delivery, it does not make the output safe: exploitable if CSRF is disabled or the token is obtained, otherwise self-XSS.

RC-C5.label: true_positive
RC-C5.mechanism_family: T reflected request data in text/html
RC-C5.label_evidence: test /test-endpoint returns the 'content' query parameter as the body.

RC-C6.label: false_positive
RC-C6.label_evidence: Test endpoints echo request headers; a cross-origin attacker cannot inject markup into them (custom headers need CORS; browsers percent-encode '<' '>' in Referer).

redacted_evidence.RC-M6: validate_path_is_safe() checks a decoded/normalised copy and get_logged_model_artifact_handler forwards the raw string; with a non-local artifact store the base download_artifacts() joins the raw string under a temporary directory. Details withheld pending verification and coordinated disclosure (private note in artifacts/).

label_definitions.true_positive: a reported flow lets external input reach the sink without a check that blocks the CWE outcome
label_definitions.TP_conditional: as true_positive, but harm or delivery depends on a stated condition that is not established (environment, configuration, bypass of an unrelated control)
label_definitions.false_positive: no reported flow can produce the CWE outcome: the flow is infeasible, or a check on every reported path blocks it for the value used at the sink
label_definitions.test_code: alert in test code (not shipped); technical_label gives the flow-level judgement and is reported separately from product metrics
label_definitions.label_unit: one alert = one sink location with the flows CodeQL reports for it; flows CodeQL does not report are false negatives of the query, not part of the label
